BUD & THINGS by Ashi

The visual identity for a home and gifting studio of hand-poured candles and Jesmonite objects. Every mark here is drawn as a vector with its lettering turned into shapes, so it reproduces the same on a screen, a label or a wax seal.

Made with thought. Given with feeling.

01–04

Logo suite

Use the primary logo wherever there is room. The stacked logo fills square formats, the horizontal logo fits headers and banners, and the tagline lockup carries campaign and storytelling pieces. Every logo comes in colour, colour reverse, chocolate, terracotta, ivory, black and white.

05

Monograms

For tags, emblems, seals and embossing. Overlapping letters are cut apart with a hairline gap, so they stay readable in one colour on any surface, including foil and blind emboss.

06

Leaf mark

The bud: one terracotta leaf rising between two olive leaves. Use the simplified version below 24 px or 8 mm, where the veins would fill in.

07

Seals and stamps

For packaging seals, stickers, wax seals and hang tags. Single-colour versions go to the stamp or wax-seal maker; the sticker versions print as filled discs.

08

Backgrounds

Full colour on Ivory and Sand. On Chocolate use the colour-reverse logo with gold and sand leaves. On Olive and Terracotta use the ivory logo, since the coloured leaves lose contrast there.

09

Colour

Ivory and Sand carry most surfaces, Chocolate carries text, Terracotta is the signature accent and Gold is used sparingly. CMYK values are a starting point converted from screen colour; ask the printer for a proof before a full run.

Suggested balance on a page or pack: Ivory 40, Sand 20, Chocolate 15, Terracotta 12, Olive 6, Sage 5, Gold 2.

10

Typography

Playfair Display for the logo, headings and quotes; Montserrat for body text, UI and labels. Both are free (SIL Open Font License) and the font files are in the kit's fonts folder.

11–12

Icons and patterns

Supporting icons are drawn on a 48 px grid with a 1.5 px line. The patterns are seamless tiles; repeat them at any size.

Rules

Using the marks

Keep these few rules and the identity will stay consistent across the website, social, packaging and print.

Clear space

Keep empty space around every logo equal to the height of the B in BUD. The exported files already include a little of it.

Minimum sizes

  • Primary logo: 30 mm or 180 px wide
  • Horizontal logo: 40 mm or 160 px wide
  • Wordmark: 25 mm or 120 px wide
  • Monograms and seals: 12 mm or 48 px
  • Simplified leaf: 4 mm or 16 px

Do

  • Use the supplied files; never retype the logo
  • Pick the colourway that matches the background
  • Use one-colour versions for foil, emboss and wax

Don’t

  • Stretch, rotate, outline or add shadows
  • Recolour the leaves outside the palette
  • Place the colour logo on busy photos; use ivory on a dark area instead
  • Rearrange the leaf, wordmark and tagline
Files

What’s in the kit

Every asset is an SVG master plus transparent PNGs. Use SVG for the website and anything sent to a printer; use PNG for social media, documents and marketplaces.
